name: The Mill Table
tagline: Southern kitchen and bakery in a restored cotton mill on downtown Bremen's square.
description:
The Mill Table serves scratch-made Southern favorites in the restored Bremen Cotton Mill building. Lunch plates rotate daily, the fried chicken is a Thursday tradition, and the bakery case is stocked every morning by 7. Private dining room available for rehearsal dinners and business lunches.

Owners Dana and Rick Whitfield opened the restaurant in 2016 after twenty years in Atlanta kitchens, and they source produce from farms right here in Haralson County whenever the season allows.

name: Tallapoosa Coffee Co.
tagline: Small-batch roaster and coffee shop on Head Avenue in historic Tallapoosa.
description: Tallapoosa Coffee Co. roasts beans in-house every Monday and pulls espresso the rest of the week. The shop hosts open mic nights on second Fridays and keeps a shelf of board games for slow afternoons. Wholesale roasting available for restaurants and offices across west Georgia.

name: Big Creek BBQ
tagline: Hickory-smoked barbecue and Brunswick stew off Highway 120 in Buchanan.
description: Big Creek BBQ has been smoking pork shoulders over hickory since 1998. The Brunswick stew recipe came from founder Earl Padgett's grandmother and hasn't changed once. Catering trailers available for church homecomings, ball team banquets, and company picnics up to 500 plates.

name: Sweetwater Bakery
tagline: Custom cakes, wedding desserts, and Saturday-morning cinnamon rolls in Waco.
description: Sweetwater Bakery specializes in custom celebration cakes and wedding desserts, with a walk-in case of cookies, pies, and the cinnamon rolls that sell out most Saturdays by 10am. Tastings by appointment. Order two weeks ahead for custom work during graduation and holiday seasons.

name: Bremen Mercantile
tagline: Gifts, home goods, and Georgia-made products in the heart of downtown Bremen.
description: Bremen Mercantile carries gifts, home goods, and a growing wall of Georgia-made products — from Haralson County honey to pottery thrown two counties over. The shop anchors the north side of the downtown square and hosts sip-and-shop evenings during festival weekends.

name: Dogwood & Main Boutique
tagline: Women's clothing and accessories boutique in historic downtown Tallapoosa.
description: Dogwood & Main stocks women's clothing, jewelry, and accessories with new arrivals every Thursday. Sizes small through 3X, because style shouldn't stop at large. Follow the shop's live sales on Facebook or come see Miss Carla in person — she remembers what you bought last time.

name: Haralson Hardware & Supply
tagline: Third-generation hardware store serving Buchanan since 1952.
description: Haralson Hardware & Supply has been family-run since 1952 — the kind of store where somebody walks you to the right aisle and can tell you how to fix it, too. Plumbing, electrical, paint mixing, chain and pipe cut to length, and small-engine parts. If they don't have it, they'll order it by Friday.

name: Second Story Books
tagline: Used and new books above the old bank building on the Bremen square.
description: Second Story Books fills the second floor of the 1907 bank building with used and new titles, a strong Georgia history shelf, and a children's corner with a reading loft. Book club meets first Tuesdays; local authors get the front window. Trade in your finished paperbacks for store credit.

name: West Georgia Family Medicine
tagline: Primary care for all ages with same-week appointments in Bremen.
description: West Georgia Family Medicine provides primary care for every age — well visits, chronic care management, sports physicals, and same-week sick appointments. Drs. Amanda Cole and Marcus Tran lead a team of eight providers, with on-site labs and most insurance plans accepted, including Medicare and Medicaid.

name: Buchanan Physical Therapy
tagline: Outpatient rehab and sports injury recovery without the drive to Carrollton.
description: Buchanan Physical Therapy brings outpatient rehab to the county seat, so recovery doesn't require a 30-minute drive. Post-surgical rehab, sports injuries, balance and fall prevention, and work conditioning. Direct access welcome — in Georgia you don't need a referral to start PT.

name: Tallapoosa Pharmacy
tagline: Independent hometown pharmacy with free delivery inside the city limits.
description: Tallapoosa Pharmacy has filled prescriptions on Head Avenue since 1971. Free delivery inside the city limits, med-sync so all your refills land on one day, immunizations, and a gift section that has saved many a forgotten birthday. Ask for Gene — he's been behind the counter for 40 years.

name: Ridgeline Fitness
tagline: 24-hour gym with group classes and personal training in Bremen.
description: Ridgeline Fitness is a 24-hour key-fob gym with free weights, cardio, turf, and a group class schedule that runs from 5:30am boot camp to evening yoga. First class is free. Student and senior rates available, and corporate memberships for chamber businesses at a discount.

name: Hutcheson & Reeves CPAs
tagline: Tax, bookkeeping, and payroll for west Georgia small businesses.
description: Hutcheson & Reeves handles tax preparation, monthly bookkeeping, payroll, and new-business setup for small businesses across Haralson and Carroll counties. The firm offers a free first-year consultation for new chamber members and runs a QuickBooks workshop every January before tax season.

name: Little Tallapoosa Law Group
tagline: Real estate closings, wills, and small business law in Tallapoosa.
description: Little Tallapoosa Law Group focuses on the legal work families and small businesses actually need: real estate closings, wills and estates, business formation, and contracts. Attorneys Renee Baskin and J.T. Colquitt offer plain-English consultations and flat-fee pricing on most routine matters.

name: Haralson Insurance Agency
tagline: Independent insurance agency protecting Haralson County families since 1958.
description: Haralson Insurance Agency is an independent agency representing a dozen carriers, which means they shop your rate instead of selling one company's product. Home, auto, farm, life, and commercial coverage. Three generations of the Segars family have run the office on Main Street in Buchanan.

name: Westside Print & Sign
tagline: Banners, vehicle wraps, business cards, and screen printing in Bremen.
description: Westside Print & Sign produces banners, yard signs, vehicle wraps, business cards, and screen-printed apparel — most jobs turned around in three business days. They print the banners for half the festivals in the county and offer chamber members 10% off first orders.

name: Calhoun Custom Homes
tagline: Custom home builder crafting family homes across Haralson County for 25 years.
description: Calhoun Custom Homes has built more than 300 homes across Haralson and surrounding counties — custom builds on your land, whole-home renovations, and a small number of spec homes each year. Licensed and insured, with a design process that starts with your budget, not against it.

name: Steadman Roofing
tagline: Residential roofing, repairs, and free storm-damage inspections out of Waco.
description: Steadman Roofing handles shingle and metal roofing, repairs, and gutter work across west Georgia. Free storm-damage inspections and help navigating insurance claims after hail season. Every crew is led by a Steadman — no subs on your roof that the family hasn't trained.

name: Haralson Heating & Air
tagline: HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance plans with 24/7 emergency service.
description: Haralson Heating & Air installs and services heating and cooling systems for homes and businesses county-wide. Maintenance plan members get priority scheduling and two tune-ups a year. When the AC quits in an August heat wave, the emergency line answers around the clock.

name: Tallapoosa Valley Landscaping
tagline: Landscape design, hardscapes, and commercial grounds maintenance.
description: Tallapoosa Valley Landscaping designs and installs landscapes, patios, and retaining walls, and maintains commercial grounds for businesses that want the curb appeal handled. Spring cleanup slots book out by February — get on the list early.

name: Bremen Tire & Auto
tagline: Tires, brakes, alignments, and honest diagnostics since 1979.
description: Bremen Tire & Auto has kept west Georgia rolling since 1979 — tires, brakes, alignments, and full diagnostics with straight answers about what can wait and what can't. Free tire rotation for life on any set purchased in-store. Coffee's always on in the waiting room.

name: Highway 78 Motors
tagline: Quality used trucks and SUVs with in-house financing in Tallapoosa.
description: Highway 78 Motors specializes in used trucks and SUVs, every one inspected before it hits the lot. In-house financing available, and they'll tell you plainly what a vehicle's been through — the Carfax is printed and sitting on the dash. Trade-ins welcome.

name: Buchanan Quick Lube
tagline: 10-minute oil changes, no appointment needed, right off the Buchanan square.
description: Buchanan Quick Lube gets you in and out in about ten minutes — oil changes, filters, wiper blades, and fluid top-offs with no appointment and no upsell pressure. Fleet accounts available for local businesses running multiple vehicles.

name: Waco Truck & Trailer
tagline: Trailer sales, hitch installation, and heavy truck service on Highway 78.
description: Waco Truck & Trailer sells utility, cargo, and gooseneck trailers, installs hitches and brake controllers, and services heavy trucks for the farms and contractors of west Georgia. DOT inspections done on site. If it tows or gets towed, they work on it.

name: Little River Farms
tagline: Family farm with seasonal produce stand, pumpkin patch, and event barn.
description: Little River Farms is a fourth-generation family farm with a seasonal produce stand (May–October), a fall pumpkin patch with hayrides, and a restored event barn that hosts weddings and the chamber's annual Harvest Dinner. Strawberries in May are the main event — follow the farm on Facebook for picking days.

name: Haralson Feed & Seed
tagline: Feed, seed, fencing, and farm supplies — and the best front-porch advice in Waco.
description: Haralson Feed & Seed stocks livestock feed, garden seed, fencing, and farm supplies, with bulk delivery for cattle operations. Spring chick days every March draw folks from three counties. The front porch checker table is original equipment, and the advice there is free.

name: Twin Oaks Nursery
tagline: Trees, shrubs, and native plants grown for west Georgia soil and summers.
description: Twin Oaks Nursery grows trees, shrubs, and perennials selected to survive west Georgia clay and August heat. The native plant section keeps expanding because customers keep asking. Free planting guides with every purchase, and delivery available on orders over $200.

name: West Georgia Outfitters
tagline: Hunting, fishing, and camping gear with local guides on staff.
description: West Georgia Outfitters stocks hunting, fishing, and camping gear, with a live bait cooler and a staff that actually hunts and fishes the land they're advising you about. Georgia licenses sold in store. Ask about guided trips on the Tallapoosa River in kayak season.

name: Haralson County Historical Society
tagline: Preserving county history at the 1892 courthouse museum in Buchanan.
description: The Haralson County Historical Society operates the museum in the 1892 courthouse on the Buchanan square, maintains the county archives, and leads cemetery preservation projects. Open Thursday through Saturday, with genealogy volunteers on hand Fridays. Membership starts at $20 a year and funds it all.

name: Bremen Arts Alliance
tagline: Community theater, gallery nights, and youth art camps in downtown Bremen.
description: The Bremen Arts Alliance runs the community theater's three annual productions, monthly gallery nights featuring west Georgia artists, and summer art camps that fill up fast. Volunteer builders, painters, and ushers always welcome — no experience required, enthusiasm mandatory.

name: Helping Hands of Haralson
tagline: Food pantry and emergency assistance serving families county-wide.
description: Helping Hands of Haralson operates the county's largest food pantry, plus emergency utility and rent assistance for families in crisis. Distribution days are Tuesday and Saturday mornings. Local businesses sponsor the backpack program that sends weekend meals home with 200 students.

name: Haralson Youth Sports Foundation
tagline: Scholarships, equipment, and league fees so every kid can play ball.
description: The Haralson Youth Sports Foundation covers league fees, cleats, and equipment for kids whose families can't swing the cost of a season. Funded by the annual chamber golf tournament and business sponsorships, the foundation put 340 kids on a field or court last year.
